# Vendored openpi source — pinned (openpi column)

- Repo: https://github.com/Physical-Intelligence/openpi
- Commit: `215abfb217dbac7d5f1273282331b9b1866c0479` (main as of 2026-10-02; committed 2026-08-24)
- Fetched: 2026-10-02

openpi reads LeRobot datasets through LeRobot itself, pinned to `0cf8648` (`pyproject.toml:70`);
that code is in [`../lerobot_0cf8648/`](../lerobot_0cf8648/). Filenames are the repo path with
`/` replaced by `_`. Do not edit; to re-pin, fetch into a new `openpi_<sha7>/` directory and
record what moved in `NOTES.md`.

License: openpi is Apache License 2.0; a copy is in [`LICENSE`](LICENSE). The files here are
unmodified copies, kept so that every citation in this project can be checked offline.
